payload.title: Flash flood warning hits Kerrville
payload.detail: NWS-style warning (simulated). The Guadalupe rises and low roads turn red.

payload.headline: SIMULATED: Flash Flood Warning for Kerr County. Guadalupe River rising rapidly. Turn around, don't drown.

payload.title: Pre-trip text with a safer route
payload.detail: Teammate A's usual route crosses a flooded road, so they get a text before leaving. A teen driver's parent gets a copy.

payload.title: Driving toward a flooded crossing
payload.detail: Teammate B is driving. The app speaks 'Turn around' before the water and reroutes on dry roads.

payload.body: Flooded road ahead. Turn around.
Flooded road ahead. Turn around.

payload.title: Car stopped in floodwater at night
payload.detail: Margaret, 78, stalls in a flooded low spot at night. Flood Watch calls her. No answer.

payload.body: Are you okay? Is water around your car? Reply: I'm safe / I need help.

timeline.text: Voice call to driver (mock, sent): no answer yet

payload.body: State Farm Flood Watch: Margaret Hale's car has stopped in floodwater near 30.0360, -99.1361 and they haven't answered. Responders are being notified. Reply SAFE if you've reached them.
This is State Farm Flood Watch calling about Margaret Hale.

timeline.text: Voice call to driver (mock, sent): no answer yet
Text + call to daughter Teammate C (demo relative) (mock, sent)

payload.title: Family contacted, responders flagged
payload.detail: Her daughter (Teammate C) gets a text and a call. High risk, so the case goes to responders right away.
